<p class="skill-reference-meta"><span>Arcantry 1.0.0</span><code>$capture-project-work</code></p>

Capture one project thought at its current commitment level. Use for hot notes, follow-ups, accepted intent, release meaning, or repeatable workflow observations that must enter todo, OpenSpec, changelog, or the skill pipeline without duplication.

## Link this skill

```text
arcantry skills link capture-project-work --scope user
arcantry skills link capture-project-work --scope user --agent claude
arcantry skills link capture-project-work --scope user --agent gemini
```

The default target is the Codex-compatible Agent Skills directory. Use the explicit agent profile for Claude Code or Gemini CLI.

## Compatibility

Source kinds: `openspec`, `changelog`, `todo-txt`.

## Learning outcomes

- Route incoming work to todo, OpenSpec, changelog, or the skill improvement pipeline.
- Preserve shared and private scope while avoiding duplicate project knowledge.

## Examples

### Capture a hot project thought

**Prompt**

> Use $capture-project-work to record this unrefined implementation thought without changing accepted product specifications.

**Expected outcome**

The thought is captured in the appropriate todo source with its scope and wording preserved.

### Record an accepted decision

**Prompt**

> Use $capture-project-work to place this approved product decision in the correct project source without writing release history yet.

**Expected outcome**

The accepted intent is represented in OpenSpec and unrelated sources remain unchanged.
